resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's Built field gives 1939, while its description says a 1928 tower on the same site fell in the 1938 hurricane. The 1939 date belongs to the present tower; both are recorded as separate events.
The register spells the museum Fischer Museum; Harvard Forest's own site uses Fisher Museum. The story follows Harvard's spelling.

notes_for_editor: Single register source for the tower's history; the Harvard Forest page only confirms the museum name and a 1930s diorama scene, not this tower. The 2016 visit report is the newest condition evidence found. No staffing history, notable fires, or current owner statement found. Search snippets (not read, not cited) mention a Prospect Hill site and a Phillipston Historical Society; check those before any update.
